question: Does a user-defined ordinary SubTaskType.SUTID, without angle brackets, bind to a preparation TaskBreakDown row and execute its authored duration, distinct from the predefined <INSPECT> identifier?

catalog.instructional_prerequisites: B02 and A12 scopes already accepted in the source B05.var03 package

accepted_source_pair.accepted_behavior: The ordinary custom INSPECT row and predefined <INSPECT> contrast have the same 7-7.166667 SEQ1 work, 7.166667-7.5 custom SERVICE SEQ2 work, h8-10 successful mission, and complete matching physical logs and result tables except description.

manual.interpretation: SubTaskType defines ordinary user identifiers, TaskBreakDown refers to them by exact SUTID, while angle-bracket predefined identifiers are separate reserved subtask types.

predeclared_acceptance: Use only read-only reclassification of the accepted B05.var03 ordinary/predefined contrast. Verify both exact inputs, both closures, all raw SHA/size seals, source review and published Git byte pins; launch no native process or duplicate run.

Require ordinary source SubTaskType rows INSPECT and SERVICE and TaskBreakDown PREP-FIXED SEQ1 INSPECT DURN=1/6, SEQ2 SERVICE DURN=1/3. Require the predefined contrast to change only the planned description and SEQ1 SUTID to <INSPECT>, preserving SEQ2 SERVICE and durations. Verify exact authored import/export binding of all populated tables.

Require source-bound native evidence that both runs execute SEQ1 7-7.166667 and SEQ2 7.166667-7.5, then successful mission h8-10, with no failure, resource wait or cancellation. The log's generic subtask label cannot alone prove SUTID; source plus exact roundtrip binding must establish it.

Reconcile all report cells in both runs: ResultSummary, 72 half-hour System and Stock bins, description difference, and terminal one ready aircraft. Preserve the ordinary and predefined raw byte identities, even if model.log bytes happen to match.
A separate standard-library read-only reviewer must check source/raw/Git pins, exact diff, two event timelines and full reports before a bounded evidence-index and simlox/main publication.
limits: This is retrospective classification of one accepted preparation pair; no independent new B05.var06 native replication, other custom SUTIDs or task categories are observed.
Identical event logs do not prove all predefined INSPECT semantics equal an ordinary custom row, nor GUI visual or cross-engine parity. Full B05.var06 and Issue #18 remain open.
K01/K08 GUI capture and K06 remain blocked; I07 opening-stock-three, E05.var02 exact-time, A01.var04 and J05 remain excluded.
